_comment: Liveness probes for the upstream sites these plugins depend on.
Run automatically at the end of tools/build-repo.ps1 so domain rot is
caught at build time instead of by users.
Why body checks matter: these sites answer an app-gate page with HTTP 200,
so a status-only check would report a dead provider as healthy. Assert on the
name        - label shown in the report
contains    - substring(s) the body MUST contain
notContains - substring(s) the body must NOT contain (e.g. gate pages)
Add an entry whenever a provider changes its upstream domain.

checks.name: OttSource / PrimeVideo search API
checks._note: PV omits the status key when there are no results, so assert on the JSON envelope instead.

checks.name: OttSource / ad-bypass host
checks._note: Must resolve. net77.cc has no userver.* DNS record.
